reviews.text:
The owner arrives 25 minutes late to opening time with glazed eyes, and doesn't apologize for the delay.

And it's not the first time!

I've asked for advice twice in the last few months, which was refused because it requires a €29 consultation fee.
This practice lacks humanity and respect.
I highly recommend this fabulous clinic, where animals are treated with gentleness and care. Whether it's a cat or a pigeon, they will receive the same high-quality treatment.

Justine Bonci is truly a fantastic exotic animal vet. She treated my rabbit twice for a dental problem that my previous vet hadn't been able to diagnose. He arrived in very poor condition, and today, thanks to her, he's very healthy and happy. You can entrust your pet to her without any hesitation, and she'll give you sound advice because she's an expert in her field.

Fantastic team, all smiling and welcoming, very professional vets who give us lots of valuable advice! If they treated humans, I wouldn't hesitate to go there myself!
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM!
Excellent service, caring and very responsive veterinary team. They are truly dedicated to taking care of our animals. Thank you to the whole team.

I found my kitten abandoned on a highway, not yet weaned, his little tail was dried out, he had ringworm, the whole nine yards! 😿 But thanks to the patience of the dedicated staff at this clinic in Endoume, Marseille 13007, he's become the most beautiful and beloved cat in my neighborhood! 😺 Just look at these photos! He follows me everywhere like a little dog, I adore him!

I've been to this veterinary clinic several times for my two cats, Rheagar and Salem, and I've always received excellent service. The entire team takes exceptional care of animals and is very caring! I recommend it 10,000%!

A word of advice: don't order food or other products from this veterinary clinic. The prices are outrageous.
The same product that costs €22 at another clinic costs €32 here—a markup of €10!

Furthermore, their communication is appalling. Before ordering, I asked them the price, and they told me €24, but when I went to pick up my order, the price was €33. It's a complete rip-off...

The team has been taking care of my dog ​​Tofu for a long time now, and I can only recommend them and thank them for their kindness, care, and gentleness.

Thank you for everything!

Having recently moved to Marseille, I was looking for a new vet for my cat. I'm so glad I found this clinic.
The staff are lovely, attentive, and incredibly caring towards your pet, taking the time to see you properly.
I highly recommend them!
Conscientious, friendly, and always on time

A huge thank you to Dr. Sisiain for her dedication and compassion towards our four-legged friends. A woman of incredible gentleness, insightful, sensitive, and honest. The best veterinarian we've ever had. Thank you, Doctor.

I came to have my French bulldog vaccinated, and I highly recommend this clinic.
The veterinarian and the receptionist were both very professional and kind.
Very friendly! Warm welcome and professionalism were evident.
great team
Absolutely fantastic!

I'm not one for Google reviews and comments, but I can only sing the praises of this practice... "my vets," as I affectionately call them :)... always available and attentive. A fantastic team, for better or for worse... I can't name you all here, but a huge thank you for being there!!
Sophie

Excellent veterinary clinic; the reception is warm and the premises are clean.
The veterinarian is very gentle and attentive; I highly recommend them.
For me, the best veterinary clinic in town. Attentive, available, and honest. My cat loves the team too, and he has a very good intuition :D

I've been going there for several months now. I'm very happy. From the assistants to the doctors, everyone is conscientious and kind. Riri is thrilled to go to the vet!*

*: not quite
Top-notch vet!

This clinic has been my pets' vet for several years.

I had an appointment for an ultrasound for my cat, Socrates, who was dying of cancer.

The previous week, during a consultation, a mass was indeed detected. The clinic simply advised me to have an ultrasound done for €192, but several days later, even though my cat was very ill. I made an appointment for the following week.

On the day of the ultrasound appointment, after waiting for an hour and a half (I was working right after, so the time was perfectly timed), they sent me home without examining my cat, without taking blood, and telling me that the vets weren't available! I never asked for this; just a simple "hello" and "sorry we're running late." Rescheduling the appointment for a few hours would have been enough.

I was crying over my cat. I've been a client for years, I made an appointment and was prepared to pay 192 euros. I didn't complain, I just said I couldn't wait any longer because I had to work.

When I said that Socrates was fed up with being in a bag when he's so unwell, and that his stomach had been swollen since last week, the vet replied, "Why are you doing an ultrasound if it's not worth it?" (It was on their advice since nothing else had been suggested).

So I left distraught at work with Socrates still very unwell, and then went to another vet that same evening. The vet was excellent, but very surprised that neither blood tests, nor an ultrasound, nor any treatment were given to Socrates, my old cat, who has a lump that even I can feel (and I'm not a vet!), diarrhea, and no appetite...

I'm disappointed and angry with this clinic. I started out as a neighborhood vet, but when clients came in, I treated them like dirt, and my cat too... Sometimes being in charge leads to an inflated ego or apathy, because you leave without caring, at the expense of animal care.

I'll never go there again and I strongly advise against it.

I have a little cat named Cloé, who is 14 years old. Unfortunately, she had cancer, and after treatments and medication from May to November 2024, because she was suffering too much, I had to have her euthanized.
I had it done at the clinic on Saturday, November 2nd, 2024, in the morning. I've had cats for 43 years, and I've seen many veterinarians and clinics, but never like the one in Endoume.
From the reception staff to the veterinarians, I have never felt so much love, compassion, understanding, and gentleness. When my little Cloé received the anesthetic injection before the final euthanasia injection, the veterinarian who was with me in the room left me alone with Cloé for a moment to experience her last moments of life in privacy.
It's a sign of tenderness that you rarely find elsewhere.

I'll say it again...this clinic and the people who work there are truly filled with love, compassion, gentleness, and profound humanity...I mean it...
I highly recommend it.

Jean-François 💗❤️💓
The staff at reception and the vets are absolutely lovely...attentive, friendly, and very professional. I highly recommend them, and so does Tootsie.

Nice little shop. Excellent service and a super competent vet who was also gentle with my puppy ⚓
Plus, a great donation box where people give toys and supplies to others 👏 …

The veterinarian and veterinary assistants are incredibly kind and attentive.

You can feel their love and passion for animals.

A small, friendly veterinary practice where you're always warmly welcomed by both the receptionists and the veterinarians. Dr. Cardinaud always takes the time to talk with you and treats your pets with gentleness! She's very professional, cheerful, reassuring, and always offers excellent advice! I have complete confidence in her.
Top
